rules.title: Context isolation
rules.text: Keep contextIsolation on and nodeIntegration off in renderers.

rules.title: Narrow preload API
rules.text: Expose a minimal typed API through the preload script and validate IPC messages in the main process.

rules.title: Content Security Policy
rules.text: Set a strict Content Security Policy and never load remote code in privileged windows.

rules.title: Signed auto-updates
rules.text: Ship signed builds with a secure auto-update channel.
